items.headline: Council to discuss Highway 17 congestion relief project
items.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council held a study session on the State Route 17 Corridor Congestion Relief Project, a state highway that many South Bay commuters use daily.

items.headline: City in closed-door talks over Finch Avenue property
items.summary: The City Council held a closed session to discuss real property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue, with the City Manager and Interim City Attorney serving as the city's negotiators.

items.headline: Chagee tea shop permitted at Saratoga Avenue plaza
items.summary: A tenant improvement permit worth $650,000 was issued for a Chagee restaurant space at 1600 Saratoga Avenue, suggesting the tea chain is preparing a new San José location.

items.headline: Escape Room venue permitted on Blossom Hill Road
items.summary: A $949,000 assembly-use permit was issued for an Escape Room location at 925 Blossom Hill Rd, a sizable buildout for an entertainment venue in that shopping area.
